clips.text: He walks into a pitch-black cave. No torch. No light at all.
He clicks his tongue once — and walks straight through it, without touching a single wall.
No eyes. No light. No map. He has never seen the sky in his life. So how does he see the cave?
The doctors checked his eyes first. Then they checked his brain. And what they found changes what seeing even means.
He is not seeing with his eyes at all. He is seeing with something else entirely — something you already have inside your own head.
So what does he see when he clicks? The full story is on Ghazi What If — and the answer is not what you think.
